reply.text: Knees that crack and pop at 5am are a question for a doctor or physio, not a coach, so I'll leave that one alone. If anything hurts or swells, get it looked at. On the training side, I'm happy to keep going, and I'll check what's on your program for today. The program lookup came back empty, so I can't see a scheduled session for you right now. If you're on a program in the app, open it from the Workouts tab and it'll show today's session. If you're not on one yet, tell me what you want to train and I'll help you work out the approach.
